8 top-down pixel art nature & terrain assets for RPG,
adventure, and dungeon-crawler style games.

Part of the Feudal Japan series:
  Vol.1 — Props & Objects
  Vol.2 — Structures & Architecture
  Vol.3 — Nature & Terrain  ← YOU ARE HERE
  Bundle — Complete Pack    (paid, all 3 vols)

── SPECS ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  Size        : 32 x 32 px per asset
  Perspective : Top-down (bird's eye view)
  Format      : PNG with transparent background (RGBA)
  Palette     : 141 colors
  Spritesheet : 138 x 70 px (4 cols x 2 rows, 2px gap)

  Tileable assets:
    → 02_koi_pond_tile      tiles seamlessly (all directions)
    → 04_bamboo_grove       tiles seamlessly (all directions)
    → 07_mossy_stone_path   tiles seamlessly (all directions)

── COMPATIBILITY ─────────────────────────────────────────

  ✓  RPG Maker MZ / MV / XP
  ✓  Godot Engine
  ✓  Unity (2D)
  ✓  GameMaker Studio 2
  ✓  LDtk / Tiled (map editors)
